question.prompt: A class has \(x\) boys and 3 fewer girls than boys, so the total number of students is \(x+(x-3)\). When \(x=25\), how many students are in the class?

solutions.explanation: The number of girls is \(x-3\), and the total number of students is \(x+(x-3)=2x-3\). When \(x=25\), \(2\times25-3=47\).
solutions.title: Simplify and substitute
